saidsurucu-trdizin-skill-root.description: Use when the user wants to search TR Dizin (trdizin.gov.tr — TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM national academic index) for publications, journals, authors, or institutions; do field-scoped advanced search (title/author/abstract/journal/doi/year/…); apply facet filters (access type, year, language, subject, document type); read a publication's references; or extract a publication PDF as text. Uses the open public JSON API over plain HTTPS — no login, no CAPTCHA, no API key.
